title: Branch Management Workflow
definition: The process of managing and coordinating branches in a Git repository to ensure that changes are merged correctly.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Workflow for keeping track of different versions of a project and making sure updates from one version make it to the correct place.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A systematic method for handling multiple branches in a Git repository, merging changes correctly and maintaining version control.
difficulty_levels.expert: A workflow for managing branches in a Git repository, designed to maintain version control and ensure changes are merged correctly, particularly when dealing with diverged branches or merging changes from local and remote repositories.

extra_fields.insight: The workflow enables efficient handling of multiple branches in a Git repository, ensuring seamless integration of changes across different versions.
